question: Could you explain the LLaVA series or variants? How they envolve over time?

ingredients.name: answer_critical_0
ingredients.criterion: Identify LLaVA as the first vision-language model trained on synthetic multimodal instruction-following data generated by language-only GPT-4.
examples: LLaVA is the first VLM trained on GPT-4-generated language-image instruction data
Uses synthetic multimodal instructions from GPT-4

ingredients.name: answer_critical_1
ingredients.criterion: Describe the architectural evolution from the simpler linear projector in LLaVA V1 to the stronger fully-connected (MLP) vision-language connector in LLaVA-1.5.
examples: LLaVA-1.5 replaces the linear projector with an MLP connector
Stronger fully-connected connector yields better alignment

ingredients.name: answer_critical_2
ingredients.criterion: State that LLaVA-OneVision is the first single model to simultaneously push open LMM performance boundaries in single-image, multi-image, and video scenarios.
examples: First single model to excel in single-image, multi-image, and video scenarios
One unifying model across three CV scenarios

ingredients.name: answer_critical_3
ingredients.criterion: Explain that LLaVA-OneVision was developed by consolidating insights into data, models, and visual representations from the LLaVA-NeXT blog series.
examples: Consolidates data, model, and visual representation insights from LLaVA-NeXT blogs
Built from accumulated experience across the blog series

ingredients.name: answer_critical_4
ingredients.criterion: Mention that the image-only-trained LLaVA-NeXT shows surprisingly strong zero-shot video performance, thanks to the AnyRes design that treats any vision signal as a sequence of images.
examples: AnyRes lets image-trained models digest video as image sequences
Zero-shot modality transfer from images to videos

ingredients.name: answer_critical_5
ingredients.criterion: State that the Stronger blog demonstrates that cost-efficient scaling up of the LLM alone achieves performance comparable to GPT-4V on selected benchmarks.
examples: Scaling up the LLM achieves GPT-4V-level performance on selected benchmarks
LLM scaling is a cost-efficient improvement strategy

ingredients.name: valuable_0
ingredients.criterion: Enumerate several LLaVA follow-up variants (e.g., LLaVA-Video, LLaVA-Stronger, LLaVA-Ablation, LLaVA-Interleave) that enhance performance and widen applications.
examples: Follow-ups include LLaVA-Video, LLaVA-Stronger, LLaVA-Ablation, LLaVA-Interleave
Series of works extending LLaVA to new scenarios

ingredients.name: valuable_1
ingredients.criterion: Note that LLaVA-OneVision's design enables strong transfer learning across modalities/scenarios, yielding new emerging capabilities such as image-to-video task transfer.
examples: Image-to-video transfer yields emerging video understanding
Strong cross-scenario transfer yields emerging capabilities

ingredients.name: valuable_2
ingredients.criterion: Frame the answer as an evolution over time, noting that the latest series of works are introduced together in one paper offering an overview of the full evolution process.
examples: The series shows a clear evolution from data generation to multi-scenario models
Latest works co-introduced in one paper overviewing the evolution
